title: AgentWallet Protocol
summary: Give an agent per-transaction and daily SOL limits with a platform fee, and settle SOL escrows by funder release or arbiter refund.
what: AgentWallet is an Anchor 0.31.1 program. An organisation creates agent wallets with spending limits; transfer_with_limit enforces them and splits off a basis-point fee. Separately, create_escrow locks SOL in a PDA that the funder or arbiter can release to the recipient, or the arbiter can refund.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentwallet/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentwallet-protocol.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentwallet/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran the transfer and escrow flows.

diagram: admin --initialize_platform_config--> config; org --create_agent_wallet--> agent_wallet; authority --transfer_with_limit--> recipient (+net), fee_wallet (+fee); funder --create_escrow--> escrow PDA --release_escrow--> recipient | --refund_escrow--> funder.
innovation: Per-agent spending caps and a daily window are tracked on-chain, so off-chain agent runners share one auditable limit record.
exercises: Whose SOL does transfer_with_limit actually move?
Who may call refund_escrow before expiry?
